correction.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the istio-cni container's securityContext.privileged default changes to false in favor of feature-specific permissions; istio-cni still counts as a privileged container under Pod Security Standards (CAP_SYS_ADMIN), and it keeps working with a different security context.

consequence.statement: After upgrade the istio-cni pod runs with privileged: false and feature-specific capabilities instead of full privileged mode; it is still classified as privileged under Pod Security Standards (CAP_SYS_ADMIN). No failure is stated.
